title: Contract Machine Learning Engineer - Outside IR35
description:
Rate: £600 per day (Outside IR35)
Contract Length: 3 Months
Location: Hybrid / Remote

An opportunity for an experienced Machine Learning Engineer to join a growing data team delivering innovative ML solutions. You'll work closely with stakeholders to develop, deploy, and optimise machine learning models that drive business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning models.
  • Develop scalable data and feature engineering pipelines.
  • Optimise model performance and production readiness.
  • Work with large datasets to solve complex business challenges.
  • Collaborate with Data Scientists, Engineers, and Product teams.
  • Support model testing, validation, and deployment.
Key Skills
  • Strong Python and SQL skills.
  • Experience building and deploying ML models in production.
  • Hands-on knowledge of machine learning frameworks (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Data engineering and pipeline development experience.
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong understanding of software engineering best practices.
  • Experience working in agile environments.

Contract: 3 Months | £600/day Outside IR35
